title: Can Editing LLMs Inject Harm?
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the increase in biased or stereotyped responses related to religious groups after a single, targeted "editing attack". Specifically, it evaluated the change in the 'Bias Score' on religion-related questions from the BBQ dataset after injecting a stereotyped sentence (e.g., "Bank controllers are Jewish") into the model.
findings: A single biased sentence injection targeting religion can effectively be inserted into LLMs and cause a catastrophic degradation of the model's overall fairness. Injecting one stereotyped sentence about a religious group not only increased the Bias Score for religion but also increased bias scores across other unrelated categories like gender, race, and sexual orientation.
